priorities.heading: Making New Mexico More Affordable
priorities.quote: With everything costing more under the Trump administration, no one should be scammed out of their money or face hidden fees. I introduced legislation banning surveillance pricing at grocery stores and am fighting to end junk fees.

priorities.heading: Delivering for New Mexicans
priorities.quote: New Mexico deserves good-paying jobs. I’m fighting for federal investment in infrastructure, clean energy, manufacturing, workforce training, and our National Labs.

priorities.heading: Keeping New Mexicans Safe
priorities.quote: I secured millions in federal funding to improve the safety of New Mexico neighborhoods.

cost-of-living.heading: Scams and junk fees
cost-of-living.quote: With everything costing more under the Trump administration, no one should be scammed out of their money or face hidden fees. I introduced legislation banning surveillance pricing at grocery stores and am fighting to end junk fees.

housing.heading: Housing
housing.quote: I helped pass the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act to provide federal incentives for new housing, cheaper financing for manufactured and modular homes, and less red tape.

health-care.heading: Prescription drugs
health-care.quote: I helped pass the law letting Medicare negotiate drug prices, capped insulin at $35 a month, and capped seniors’ out-of-pocket drug costs.

immigration.heading: Accountability for DHS and ICE
immigration.quote: I’ve introduced legislation to mandate training for ICE and CBP officers and hold them accountable for the violence and chaos they have caused in our streets.

climate-energy.heading: Energy and gas prices
climate-energy.quote: I helped pass historic clean energy tax credits and efficiency rebates and have sponsored legislation to bring down energy costs.

priorities.heading: A Secure Border for a Safer New Mexico
priorities.quote: I will use the appropriations process to tie Department of Homeland Security funding to strict performance metrics, ensuring that resources are only directed to programs that achieve verifiable, 100% border surveillance and interdiction.

priorities.heading: The Engine of Our State
priorities.quote: I will introduce and champion legislation that mandates strict, non-negotiable "shot-clocks" for federal energy permitting.

priorities.heading: Stop the lawfare against the people who feed
priorities.quote: Larry Marker’s position is simple: the people who work the land should not be punished by unelected bureaucracies acting like they answer to nobody.
